Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Deer Park for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (Reindeer Park at Jimmy Burke Activity Center) through December 23 (Elf Camp), with December 12 (Swimming with Santa and the Gingerbread House Decorating Class), December 19 (Pancakes & Pajamas at Deer Park Theatre Building) and December 15 (Geocaching 'Twas the Night at Dow Park) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Deer Park

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Deer Park
  • 1 free event, the Winter Holiday Storytime and Movie Matinee at Deer Park Public Library
  • Meet Santa: Reindeer Park, Swimming with Santa, Pancakes & Pajamas
  • Crafts and classes: Gingerbread House Decorating Class at Dow Active Complex
  • Trains: a trip to the Polar Express Train Ride during Elf Camp
  • Season: December 5 to December 23

Planning a bigger day out? Deer Park families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers Zoo Lights at the Houston Zoo, The Nutcracker with Houston Ballet, skating with Santa at Discovery Green and the Polar Express train ride.
